sections.heading: Overview
bullets: No enrage-driven damage check until 8 minutes — this fight is about not getting displaced into a bad spot or caught by the group-wide spike.

sections.heading: Displacement (red circles)
bullets: 3 red circles spawn around the arena — standing in one when it detonates deals damage and teleports you to a random spot in the arena. Dangerous mainly because it can combine with a knockback from something else. Dodge out if you can, or use a mobility skill to escape and reposition back to the squad immediately.

sections.heading: Spatial Manipulation (green circles)
bullets: Green circles appear with gold orbs above them — each needs a minimum number of players matching its orb count to activate. Being outside an active circle when it detonates means heavy damage, 25 stacks of Unseen Burden, and a 2-second Float. Standing in one when it pops clears 25 Unseen Burden stacks instead.
Circles that follow Energy Surge or Orbital Sweep don't have a player-count requirement.

sections.heading: Energy Surge & Gravity Wave
bullets: Energy Surge: Cairn teleports around the platform, leaving green circles and knocking back anyone in his path — watch the directional arrows at his feet and dodge or sidestep. He always follows this with Spatial Manipulation, so the sequence is predictable.
Gravity Wave (from 25% health, after Orbital Sweep): 3 waves of energy expand outward — staying stacked close to Cairn keeps you safe from it, so don't spread out during this one.

sections.heading: Targeting & Enrage
bullets: Cairn targets the furthest player for attacks like Shared Agony and Meteor Swarm — plan positioning accordingly.
8:00 enrage — past this point Unseen Burden stacks can no longer be cleansed, so a slow group snowballs fast.
